title: Exhibitor Registration Now Open for the 2026 Edition
excerpt: Registration for exhibitor booths at the 2nd edition of the Lebanon Industrial Exposition is now open, with early-bird pricing available through August.
body: The Association of Lebanese Industrialists is pleased to announce that exhibitor registration for the 2026 edition of the Lebanon Industrial Exposition is now open.
Manufacturers across all sectors are invited to secure their booth space ahead of the early-bird deadline. Early registrants benefit from reduced rates and priority hall placement.
Interested companies can apply through the Registration page or contact the organizing committee directly for tailored packages.

title: BIEL Confirmed as Host Venue
excerpt: The Beirut International Exhibition & Leisure Center will once again host the exposition across three exhibition halls.
body: The organizing committee has confirmed the Beirut International Exhibition & Leisure Center (BIEL) as the venue for this year's exposition.
The event will occupy three exhibition halls, a dedicated conference wing, and an outdoor networking terrace, offering expanded capacity compared to previous editions.

title: New Conference Track: Sustainable Manufacturing
excerpt: This year's program introduces a dedicated track on sustainability, circular economy practices, and renewable energy for industrial facilities.
body: In response to growing demand from exhibitors and visitors, the 2026 program introduces a dedicated Sustainability & Technology track.
Sessions will cover circular economy practices, recycled materials, renewable energy adoption, and regulatory compliance for manufacturers operating in Lebanon and the broader region.

title: B2B Matchmaking Program Launched for International Buyers
excerpt: A new matchmaking program will connect exhibitors with pre-qualified international buyers and distributors throughout the event.
body: This year's exposition introduces a structured B2B matchmaking program, pairing exhibitors with pre-qualified buyers and distributors from target export markets.
Exhibitors will be able to submit their matchmaking preferences during registration, with scheduled meeting slots confirmed ahead of the event.

title: Call for Sponsors: Partnership Packages Now Available
excerpt: Platinum, gold, and silver sponsorship packages are now available for organizations looking to support the 2026 exposition.
body: The Association of Lebanese Industrialists invites financial institutions, logistics providers, and industry associations to partner with this year's exposition.
Sponsorship packages range from platinum to silver tiers, each offering a distinct combination of branding, speaking opportunities, and delegate access.
Organizations interested in sponsoring can reach out via the Contact page for a detailed prospectus.

title: Save the Date: October 28–31, 2026
excerpt: The Lebanon Industrial Exposition returns for its 2nd edition, taking place over four days this October.
body: Mark your calendars: the 2nd edition of the Lebanon Industrial Exposition will take place from October 28 to 31, 2026.
This year's event will bring together manufacturers, buyers, and industry partners from across Lebanon and the wider region for four days of exhibitions, conference sessions, and networking.
